description: This file contains inline utility functions for file content reading, property extraction, file type checking, recursive file searching, and variable expansion within strings. It is part of a utility namespace 'Utils' and provides foundational support for file and string operations in a larger C++ project.

methods.name: readPropertyFromFile
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file, with support for recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.name: readFileContent
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: isRegularFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.name: searchFilesRec
methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching patterns in directories, with support for exclusions and result cap.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Initiates recursive search for files starting from a given path.

methods.name: ExpandPropertiesInString
methods.description: Expands variables within a string by replacing them with corresponding property values from a file.
